title: Narrowing Sales Type to Labor or Parts shows only that side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: One person is both the Labor and the Parts representative on a work order invoiced today, and you narrow the report by Sales Type.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; it has one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour and one part sold at $50.00; "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" both read {Sales-rep-A}; it was invoiced today.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with the Sales Type column turned on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand {Sales-rep-A}.
  2. Set the Sales Type filter to Labor only.
  3. Set the Sales Type filter to Parts only.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1}'s invoice is one row, Sales Type "Labor, Parts".
  • Step 2: only the "Labor" side shows: {Work-order-1}'s row reads "Labor" with $200.00 of labor.
  • Step 3: only the "Parts" side shows: {Work-order-1}'s row reads "Parts" with $50.00 of parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R12: “With the Sales Type filter narrowed to Labor or to Parts, only that side's row shows (Story 8).”
  • S5-R10: “When one person, or Unassigned, holds both the Labor and the Parts side of a work order and the Sales Type filter includes both, the two show as one row whose Sales Type reads "Labor, Parts" and whose figures are the sum of both sides.”
